hook: 124 free math textbooks, written by university mathematicians

beats.say: Many university mathematicians turn years of lecture notes into a book and put it on their own page for free, and this list collects them.
The list holds 124 books across thirteen subjects, from high school algebra to graduate analysis, sorted by subject, level and format.
26 of the books also have a print edition, and the author notes each book's level, format and a short comment.
